correctness.rationale: Fix one point by U(d) homogeneity. Quotient distance equals arccos(R cos Theta) with R²~Beta(1,d-1), independent nearest-phase Theta uniform on [-pi/p,pi/p]. Conditioning yields the exact CDF and volume (2 pi^d/[p Gamma(d)])F. A shared phase-uniform and radial beta coupling proves strictly shorter distances for larger p and strictly longer for larger d at each interior CDF threshold. Independently differentiated J_j(u)=sum binom(j-1,k)u^(2k+1)/(2k+1), recovering sec^(2j) integral coefficients. For p=2, E(1/R)=sqrt(pi)Gamma(d)/Gamma(d-1/2) gives the linear tail coefficient by dominated convergence; checked exactly for d=3..11. The strict epsilon upper bound for polynomial is essential.
